name: 407. Zhipu bigmodel batch on an openai-based custom provider reaches /api/paas/v4 with the named key (bigmodel batch) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6665 regression, contract C3, C8, C12. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream (providerErrorFixtureUrl when it is not on http://127.0.0.1:8791). Every row is skipped otherwise. Zhipu bigmodel, the z.ai domestic site, serves OpenAI-shaped files and batches under /api/paas/v4. tkp_bigmodel is configured the way Tokun's reconciler writes that provider: base_provider_type openai, allowed_requests batch_* and file_*, max_retries 0, two named keys enabled for batches, and request_path_overrides for every batch and file request type. For a call that names a batch or a file the override is a template: {batch_id} or {file_id} is where the id goes (batch_retrieve /api/paas/v4/batches/{batch_id}, batch_cancel /api/paas/v4/batches/{batch_id}/cancel, file_content /api/paas/v4/files/{file_id}/content). Before the change the gateway built retrieve, cancel, results and the file calls on /v1 whatever the overrides said. The fixture answers only under /pp/bigmodel/api/paas/v4, so a call on a default path is a 404 and fails its row, and GET /__wire returns each call with the name of the key it carried. Rows: (1) an inline batch uploads its lines unchanged as a JSONL to /api/paas/v4/files and creates the batch at /api/paas/v4/batches, metadata included; (2) retrieve, (3) cancel and (4) the first results page reach /api/paas/v4/batches/{id} and /api/paas/v4/files/{id}/content; each succeeded line carries custom_id, status and an OpenAI chat body whose usage is the chat operation's unified usage, read from a batch whose endpoint the vendor spells /v4/chat/completions; (5) the page after the cursor carries the error file's line with the vendor's error. All of it with the second key, the one named in x-bf-api-key, and never the first. (6) writing a provider whose batch_retrieve override has no {batch_id} is refused. The output lines are the shape bigmodel documents (docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/guide/tools/batch.md, read 2026-11-10); no real bigmodel batch has been recorded, and the error line is OpenAI's shape, which is all the documentation says about the error file. The two results rows are tagged [NO-CONTENT]: a results page is not an inference response the collection's shape check knows, and the rows assert the page themselves. Run the whole folder in order.
